audience: online shops and logistics teams who track parcels with TrackingMore

useCases.title: Find which courier a tracking number belongs to
useCases.text: Detects the likely couriers for a tracking number and returns their codes, and can search the supported couriers by name or code.

useCases.title: Check the status and checkpoints of a parcel
useCases.text: Reads the tracking record of a registered shipment by tracking number, with its delivery status and every checkpoint with date, details and location.

useCases.title: List registered shipments by delivery status
useCases.text: Lists the shipments registered in the account with tracking number, courier and delivery status, such as transit, delivered or exception.

useCases.title: Start tracking a parcel
useCases.text: Detects the courier if needed and registers one shipment so TrackingMore starts tracking it.

useCases.title: Update or remove a tracking
useCases.text: Changes the order number, customer name or email, title, note or label of a registered tracking, or deletes the tracking and its checkpoint history.
